package main

// Postgres access for the operations designed on this service. Generated by Tessery.
// Rows come back as JSON built by Postgres, and every value goes in as text with a cast to the
// column's type, so Postgres does all type conversion.

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

//go:embed migrations/*.sql
var migrations embed.FS

var db *pgxpool.Pool

const migrationLock = 727274

// openDB connects and runs the schema script. The script only adds things, so it is safe on every
// start and on every replica.
func openDB(ctx context.Context, dsn string) {
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, dsn)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("database address: %v", err)
	}
	db = pool
	schema, err := migrations.ReadFile("migrations/__SCHEMA_FILE__")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("reading the schema: %v", err)
	}
	for attempt := 1; ; attempt++ {
		if err = migrate(ctx, string(schema)); err == nil {
			return
		}
		if attempt >= 30 {
			log.Fatalf("migrating: %v", err)
		}
		log.Printf("database not ready (%v), retrying in 2s", err)
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
	}
}

func migrate(ctx context.Context, schema string) error {
	conn, err := db.Acquire(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Release()
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, "SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)", migrationLock); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Exec(context.Background(), "SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)", migrationLock)
	_, err = conn.Conn().PgConn().Exec(ctx, schema).ReadAll()
	return err
}

// Result is a status code and a JSON body ready to send.
type Result struct {
	Status int
	Body   []byte
}

func errorResult(status int, fields map[string]string) Result {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(fields)
	return Result{Status: status, Body: b}
}

var notFound = errorResult(404, map[string]string{"error": "not_found"})

func rejected(err error) Result {
	var pg *pgconn.PgError
	if errors.As(err, &pg) {
		switch {
		case pg.Code == "23502" && pg.ColumnName != "":
			return errorResult(400, map[string]string{"error": "invalid", "field": pg.ColumnName, "detail": pg.ColumnName + " is required"})
		case pg.Code == "23505":
			return errorResult(409, map[string]string{"error": "already_exists", "detail": pg.Detail})
		case pg.Code == "23503":
			return errorResult(409, map[string]string{"error": "reference_not_found", "detail": pg.Detail})
		case strings.HasPrefix(pg.Code, "22") || strings.HasPrefix(pg.Code, "23") || pg.Code == "42703":
			return errorResult(400, map[string]string{"error": "invalid", "detail": pg.Message})
		}
	}
	log.Printf("database error: %v", err)
	return errorResult(500, map[string]string{"error": "internal"})
}

var upper = regexp.MustCompile(`([a-z0-9])([A-Z])`)

func snake(k string) string { return strings.ToLower(upper.ReplaceAllString(k, "${1}_${2}")) }

func quote(name string) string { return `"` + strings.ReplaceAll(name, `"`, `""`) + `"` }

func text(v any) any {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case nil:
		return nil
	case string:
		return x
	case bool:
		return strconv.FormatBool(x)
	case float64:
		return strconv.FormatFloat(x, 'f', -1, 64)
	case json.Number:
		return x.String()
	default:
		b, _ := json.Marshal(x)
		return string(b)
	}
}

// readBody decodes a JSON object body; anything else counts as empty.
func readBody(r io.Reader) map[string]any {
	var out map[string]any
	dec := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(r, 1<<20))
	dec.UseNumber()
	_ = dec.Decode(&out)
	return out
}

type Table struct {
	Name     string
	Key      string
	Order    string
	Types    map[string]string
	Writable []string
}

func (t Table) cast(col string, n int) string {
	typ, ok := t.Types[col]
	if !ok {
		typ = "text"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("$%d::text::%s", n, typ)
}

func (t Table) where(filter map[string]string, from int) (string, []any) {
	parts, args := []string{}, []any{}
	for k, v := range filter {
		args = append(args, v)
		parts = append(parts, quote(k)+" = "+t.cast(k, from+len(args)-1))
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, " AND "), args
}

func (t Table) pick(body map[string]any) ([]string, []any) {
	cols, vals := []string{}, []any{}
	for k, v := range body {
		c := snake(k)
		for _, w := range t.Writable {
			if w == c && c != t.Key {
				cols, vals = append(cols, c), append(vals, text(v))
			}
		}
	}
	return cols, vals
}

func (t Table) one(ctx context.Context, status int, sql string, args ...any) Result {
	var raw []byte
	err := db.QueryRow(ctx, sql, args...).Scan(&raw)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) || (err == nil && raw == nil) {
		return notFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return rejected(err)
	}
	return Result{Status: status, Body: raw}
}

func (t Table) List(ctx context.Context, q url.Values, filter map[string]string) Result {
	limit, offset := 50, 0
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("limit")); err == nil {
		limit = min(max(v, 1), 500)
	}
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("offset")); err == nil {
		offset = max(v, 0)
	}
	where, args := t.where(filter, 1)
	if where != "" {
		where = " WHERE " + where
	}
	return t.one(ctx, 200, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM %s%s ORDER BY %s LIMIT %d OFFSET %d) r", quote(t.Name), where, t.Order, limit, offset), args...)
}

func (t Table) Get(ctx context.Context, id string, filter map[string]string) Result {
	where, args := t.where(withKey(filter, t.Key, id), 1)
	return t.one(ctx, 200, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM %s r WHERE %s", quote(t.Name), where), args...)
}

func (t Table) Create(ctx context.Context, body map[string]any, fixed map[string]string) Result {
	cols, vals := t.pick(body)
	for k, v := range fixed {
		cols, vals = append(cols, k), append(vals, v)
	}
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		return t.one(ctx, 201, fmt.Sprintf("WITH r AS (INSERT INTO %s DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM r", quote(t.Name)))
	}
	names, params := make([]string, len(cols)), make([]string, len(cols))
	for i, c := range cols {
		names[i], params[i] = quote(c), t.cast(c, i+1)
	}
	return t.one(ctx, 201, fmt.Sprintf("WITH r AS (INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES (%s) RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM r", quote(t.Name), strings.Join(names, ", "), strings.Join(params, ", ")), vals...)
}

func (t Table) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, body map[string]any, filter map[string]string) Result {
	cols, vals := t.pick(body)
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		return errorResult(400, map[string]string{"error": "invalid", "detail": "nothing to update; writable fields are " + strings.Join(t.Writable, ", ")})
	}
	sets := make([]string, len(cols))
	for i, c := range cols {
		sets[i] = quote(c) + " = " + t.cast(c, i+1)
	}
	where, args := t.where(withKey(filter, t.Key, id), len(cols)+1)
	return t.one(ctx, 200, fmt.Sprintf("WITH r AS (UPDATE %s SET %s WHERE %s RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM r", quote(t.Name), strings.Join(sets, ", "), where), append(vals, args...)...)
}

func (t Table) Remove(ctx context.Context, id string, filter map[string]string) Result {
	where, args := t.where(withKey(filter, t.Key, id), 1)
	tag, err := db.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DELETE FROM %s WHERE %s", quote(t.Name), where), args...)
	if err != nil {
		return rejected(err)
	}
	if tag.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return notFound
	}
	return Result{Status: 204}
}

func withKey(filter map[string]string, key, id string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{key: id}
	for k, v := range filter {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}
